N346430  
March 27, 2025
  CLA-2-61:OT:RR:NC:N3:356  
CATEGORY: Classification  
TARIFF NO.: 6110.30.3053; 6110.30.3059
  Ms. Maurine Cecil  Western Overseas Corporation  10731 Walker Street  Cypress, CA 90630  RE:  The tariff classification of men’s and women’s upper body garments from Vietnam  Dear Ms. Cecil:  In your letter dated March 3, 2025, you requested a tariff classification ruling on behalf of your client,  Careismatic Brands LLC. Your samples will be returned as requested. Styles HH360, HH361, and IN00009  will be addressed under separate cover.  Style CK00009 is a men’s upper body garment constructed from 80 percent polyester and 20 percent spandex  knit fabric. The outer surface of the garment’s fabric measures more than nine stitches per two centimeters in  the direction the stitches were formed. Style CK00009 features a round neckline with curved front plackets; a  left-over-right, partial front opening with two snap closures; forward shoulder seams; a bungee loop at the  right shoulder seam; short, hemmed sleeves; a contrasting fabric trademark label on the left sleeve above the  hem; two patch pockets on the front panel below the waist; and a straight, hemmed bottom with a slit at each  side and a slightly longer back panel.  Style CK00006 is a women’s pullover style garment constructed from 80 percent polyester and 20 percent  spandex knit fabric. The outer surface of the garment’s fabric measures more than nine stitches per two  centimeters in the direction the stitches were formed. The pullover garment extends from the shoulders to  below the waist and features a V-shaped neckline; two pockets below the waist; short, hemmed sleeves; a  back yoke with an inverted pleat; and a curved, high-low hemmed bottom.  The applicable subheading for Style CK00009 will be 6110.30.3053, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the  United States (HTSUS), which provides for: Sweaters, pullovers, sweatshirts, waistcoats (vests) and similar  articles, knitted or crocheted: Of man-made fibers: Other: Other: Other: Other: Other: Men’s or boys’: Other.  The rate of duty will be 32 percent ad valorem.  The applicable subheading for Style CK00006 will be 6110.30.3059, HTSUS, which provides for: Sweaters,  pullovers, sweatshirts, waistcoats (vests) and similar articles, knitted or crocheted:  Of man-made fibers: 

Other: Other: Other: Other: Other: Women?s and girls?: Other.?The rate of duty will be 32 percent ad  valorem.  Duty rates are provided for your convenience and are subject to change. The text of the most recent HTSUS  and the accompanying duty rates are provided at https://hts.usitc.gov/.  The holding set forth above applies only to the specific factual situation and merchandise description as  identified in the ruling request. This position is clearly set forth in Title 19, Code of Federal Regulations  (CFR), Section 177.9(b)(1). This section states that a ruling letter is issued on the assumption that all of the  information furnished in the ruling letter, whether directly, by reference, or by implication, is accurate and  complete in every material respect. In the event that the facts are modified in any way, or if the goods do not  conform to these facts at time of importation, you should bring this to the attention of U.S. Customs and  Border Protection (CBP) and submit a request for a new ruling in accordance with 19 CFR 177.2.  Additionally, we note that the material facts described in the foregoing ruling may be subject to periodic  verification by CBP.  This ruling is being issued under the provisions of Part 177 of the Customs and Border Protection  Regulations (19 C.F.R. 177).  A copy of the ruling or the control number indicated above should be provided with the entry documents  filed at the time this merchandise is imported. If you have any questions regarding the ruling, please contact  National Import Specialist Maryalice Nowak at maryalice.nowak@cbp.dhs.gov.  
Sincerely,
   Steven A. Mack  Director  National Commodity Specialist Division
subject: The tariff classification of men’s and women’s upper body garments from Vietnam
